property_summary: When _tos is non-empty and the external call succeeds, the reference returns true; the buggy contract reverts, so a call that executes without revert indicates the reference behavior and fails on the mutant.
change_summary: Change the condition from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length == 0, which will revert on non-empty arrays and succeed on empty ones, altering the observable revert behavior.
